candidate.claim_under_test: At the pinned Agent-libOS source, public TaskRun recovery-option availability is coupled to NEEDS_ATTENTION and effect-receipt recovery additionally requires a provider verifier surface; therefore a gate-OFF factorial cannot assume unchanged public recover() availability. Determine whether the crash-harness Fsync provider exposes the required authoritative-receipt verifier as-is.

observed: recovery_options(run_id) returns an empty tuple when the Run status is not TaskRunStatus.NEEDS_ATTENTION.
For unsettled unsafe effects, an effect_receipt recovery option is emitted only when the selected provider has a callable verify_external_effect_receipt surface.
The effect_receipt option binding includes run_id, effect_id, expected_transaction_state, and runtime_epoch.
recover(...) reconstructs the current server-derived recovery option map by calling recovery_options(run_id) and rejects an option_id not present in that map.
FsyncProviderLedger durably stores effect_id, idempotency_key, outcome and an optional receipt in canonical fsynced records.
successful_receipt_for_key(idempotency_key) can return the unique succeeded receipt already in the ledger.
FsyncIdempotentJsonRpcProvider is defined without a custom superclass and uses the ledger for idempotent replay.
No verify_external_effect_receipt symbol is present in this pinned crash_harness.py.

verification_result.material_clarification: The crash harness already persists receipt material, so an adapter or provider method may be implementable, but the required verifier interface is not exposed by FsyncIdempotentJsonRpcProvider as pinned. Because TaskRunManager only generates effect_receipt recovery options for providers exposing that callable and recover() re-derives the server option set, the proposed four-cell benchmark cannot use the current Fsync provider unchanged for an effect_receipt recovery arm. Minimal-extension correctness and startup-reconciliation noninterference remain unverified.
verification_result.acceptance_reason: This slice verifies source structure only. It does not demonstrate the deterministic 2x2, a Chat-native execution route, zero-quota replay, or removal of the benchmark execution step from the outcome path. Any required benchmark/process execution remains an unresolved residual executor for Phase-1 acceptance until reproduced through an actually exposed scheduled-Chat route.
verification_result.exact_tested_scope: Only the two pinned Agent-libOS source files and the referenced long_horizon checkpoint claim were assessed. No runtime experiment, provider adapter implementation, startup reconciliation, or live-model arm was executed or inferred.

continuation.exact_next_action: On a later primary_source_verifier invocation, inspect the pinned Agent-libOS provider-registration/substrate path needed to expose verify_external_effect_receipt without changing provider truth or startup reconciliation, or verify a newer committed adapter/test if one exists. Require exact effect_id/state/runtime_epoch binding and a server-derived option test before treating the long_horizon recovery arm as implementable. Do not claim Phase-1 acceptance until an actually exposed scheduled-Chat route reproduces the needed execution with zero optional monthly quota and zero incremental cost.
